summary: Iteration 8 retest of the iteration 7 fixes. Backend: full suite 40/41 on the first run. The one failure was spotcheck test_auth_429 (13 straight 401s, no 429); it then passed in 2 reruns and 5 manual probes, so it's flaky. Added test_phase3_iter8_retest.py: revive pricing 5→10→revive_limit with the ref suffix ignored, idempotent replay, and 13 logins with rotating spoofed XFF hitting 429 on the 11th. All pass. Frontend: 3 Playwright scripts at 390x844 on the Expo web preview, 31/31 checks pass. Covered: first run from menu Play calls /runs/start + /runs/finish (no /runs/offline), with the score in db.scores and on the daily leaderboard; the Synced toast; sign-out resets the wallet to 0/0; a fresh account B gets 0/0 (none of A's 2000/50); deleting an account resets the wallet (gems 60→0); after sign-out or delete only one menu is in the stack and Escape opens the exit dialog; 4 bottom buttons 72x72 fit within 390px with nothing clipped (English and Hindi); the cloud account button (44x44) is in the top bar; Hindi labels इवेंट/खाता/लीडरबोर्ड; signed-out leaderboard shows the sign-in card and personal bests (empty state, then best-1 after a guest run); the event claim button is disabled with 'Reach 50 to claim'; the maintenance screen offers Play offline and Retry, and an offline run completes; the update banner shows Update now/Later and Later dismisses it; guest runs make no /runs calls. Remote config reset to maintenance false, 1.0.0/1.0.0.

minor.issue: Flaky: in the full-suite run, 13 logins from one real IP returned 401 x13 with no 429. It then passed 2/2 reruns and 5/5 probes. A likely cause is that egress/ingress chains of different lengths make the fwd[-3] key vary. Also, when XFF has fewer than 3 entries the code falls back to request.client.host (the LB IP), so all such clients share one bucket. Consider logging the computed key to confirm.

The revive count is keyed on the client-supplied run part of ref and isn't tied to a server-issued run/run_token. A client can rotate the run id to always pay 5 gems and get unlimited revives (it pays each time, so no currency gain).

integration_issues.flow: Server-side wallet change while app is open/reloaded
integration_issues.issue: After a direct server wallet change (mongo), a reload of /menu still showed the old local wallet (0/0 instead of 777/7). /me isn't re-fetched on launch, so the server wallet only reconciles after a run, sync or link. Low priority.

issues: The 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ' best label is uppercase-styled and letter-spaced, which breaks the Devanagari shaping. Its muted colour is also low-contrast on the sky background.

action_items: Low: investigate the flaky auth 429 (log client_ip key and XFF length) and decide the behaviour when XFF has fewer than TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS entries
Low: bind revive pricing to a server-issued run (run_token/run_id from /runs/start) rather than to a free-form ref
Low: refresh /me on app launch when signed in, so server-side wallet changes show up
Cosmetic: remove uppercase/letter-spacing for the Best label in Indic languages
critical_code_review_comments: online.clearSession() → onSignedOut resets coins/gems/hoverboards/owned/equipped to defaultSave(). As a side effect, a guest's own pre-sign-in onboarding gift (2000/50) is gone after sign-out. This is by design per the spec, but worth a UX note.
Maintenance 'Play offline' only hides the gate; signed-in online calls (/runs/start etc.) still go out during maintenance.
uvicorn --reload watches backend/tests, so adding test files restarts the backend and clears the in-memory limiter. The limiter is also per-process, so it won't hold with more than one worker.

success_rate.backend: 97.6% (40/41; the 1 failure is flaky, passes on rerun)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ accounts were registered and deleted (B, C, and the pytest user). Player had one online run added (score 495). Remote config was toggled and then reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend suite with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported (test_health needs it). The auth limiter is a real 10/min per real IP, so sleep 61s between auth-heavy groups. p3e/p3f/p3g are self-contained: each onboards fresh and needs no storage state. p3f toggles db.remote_config and resets it in finally.
rca_of_issue: All 3 iteration 7 issues are verified fixed. First run: the RunScreen mount effect calls online.startRun. Duplication: the onSignedOut reset means B gets {coins:0, gems:0}. XFF: fwd[-3] is used, and rotating spoofed XFF gets 429 on the 11th.
